blocks.title: <ico-target></ico-target> EL IELTS EN 4 PARTES
blocks.intro: El IELTS se puntúa de 0 a 9 (bandas). Tu meta es 4.5–5. La buena noticia: esa banda no pide inglés avanzado — pide inglés claro, simple y correcto que responda la pregunta.

cells.body:
4 secciones, 40 preguntas.
Lo escuchas una sola vez.

3 secciones, 40 preguntas.
Textos cotidianos y de trabajo.

Task 1: una carta (150 palabras)
Task 2: un ensayo (250 palabras)

Entrevista cara a cara.
3 partes, con un examinador real.

parts.body: IELTS tip: no necesitas palabras "difíciles". Una frase larga con errores puntúa menos que una frase simple correcta. Precisión > complejidad.

Banda 4: frases muy simples, muchos errores, cuesta entenderte. · Banda 4.5–5 : oraciones simples y correctas, respondes la pregunta, usas and / but / because. · Para subir: añade una razón y un ejemplo.

blocks.stage: ① EL EXAMEN · qué es y qué pide la banda 4.5–5

blocks.title: <ico-commentdots></ico-commentdots> SPEAKING PART 1 · LA FÓRMULA
blocks.intro: En Part 1 (~4–5 min) el examinador pregunta sobre ti: tu casa, tu trabajo, tu tiempo libre, tu rutina. Es la parte más fácil para ganar puntos. La clave: nunca contestes con una palabra.

parts.html: Míralo en acción — "Do you work or study?"

items.en: "I work. I'm a nurse in a hospital, because I like helping people. I've worked there for two years."

parts.html: Frases útiles — memorízalas, sirven para cualquier tema:

items.sp: Hoy en día, … / En este momento, …

parts.body: Añade un contraste con but y una opinión: "I like my job, but the hours are long." · Usa una frase de tiempo: "at the moment", "these days", "when I was younger". Con eso el examinador ya ve rango.

items.en: to commute / to get to work

items.sp: días de semana / fin de semana

blocks.title: <ico-star></ico-star> MARTA · CANDIDATA
blocks.intro: Marta se presenta al IELTS General Training. Primero practicas la fórmula y el formato del examen, y luego la escuchas en 2 audios: su Part 1 sobre el trabajo y sobre el tiempo libre. Fíjate en cómo nunca responde con una sola palabra.

cast.sp: enfermera de Valencia · apunta a banda 5
el examinador — hace las preguntas y cronometra

blocks.stage: ② LA ENTREVISTA · Marta hace su Speaking

blocks.title: LARGA NO SIGNIFICA BUENA
blocks.intro: Las tres opciones son largas. Solo una puntúa — las otras dos fallan por una razón concreta. Léelas enteras.

options: I started learning English at school when I was ten, and my teacher was really good.
Not very often. I use it at work maybe twice a week, mostly for writing emails.
English is very important nowadays, and I believe everybody in the world should learn to speak it.

items.q: "What do you do in your free time?"
options: Nothing special really, just the normal things that everybody does after work, you know how it is.
I like football, tennis, swimming, running, cycling, reading, cooking and also watching TV at home sometimes.
I mainly play football. I train twice a week with a local team after work.
My hometown is a marvelous and picturesque location which offers a plethora of magnificent opportunities.
Yes, I like my hometown, because my hometown is the town where I was born.
Yes. It's quite small, so everyone knows each other, but there isn't much to do.
Yes, I love cooking. Well, actually I don't cook much. I mean, sometimes, but not really.
Yes, a lot. I cook on weekends, because I get home late during the week.
Cooking is an activity that many people enjoys in their free time for relaxing themselves.
I moved there about three years ago, because I found a cheaper apartment near my job.
My neighborhood is like a normal neighborhood. It's the neighborhood where I live, quite a neighborhood.
It's pretty quiet. There's a park at the end of my street and some small shops.

blocks.stage: ③ PRACTICE · elige la respuesta

blocks.title: ¿CONOCES EL EXAMEN?
blocks.intro: Saber el formato te quita medio nervio el día del examen.

items.q: ¿Cuántas veces escuchas cada audio del Listening?
options: Dos veces
Una sola vez
Tres veces

options: Describir un gráfico
Un ensayo de 250 palabras

items.q: Para banda 4.5–5, lo más importante es…
options: Usar vocabulario muy avanzado
Frases simples correctas que respondan la pregunta
Hacer frases muy largas

items.q: En Speaking Part 1, el examinador te pregunta sobre…

La sociedad y el futuro del planeta

blocks.title: ORDENA LA FRASE
blocks.intro: Toca las palabras para formar la frase correcta.

items.answer: I work as a nurse in a hospital
I have lived there all my life
To be honest it can be stressful

blocks.title: RESPUESTA CORTA vs RESPUESTA EXTENDIDA
blocks.intro: Las dos contestan la pregunta. Una te deja en banda 4; la otra te da algo que puntuar. Esta diferencia es el examen.

pair.a: Do you work? — Yes, I do.
pair.b: Do you work? — Yes, I do. I'm a nurse at a private hospital, and I've worked there for four years.

items.q: ¿Cuál le da al examinador algo que puntuar?
options: Las dos igual
A — respuesta corta
B — respuesta + razón + detalle

items.q: ¿Qué le falta a la respuesta A?
options: Gramática correcta
Una razón y un detalle
Vocabulario difícil

items.q: Te preguntan por tu ciudad. ¿Qué respondes?
options: I'm from Valencia.
I'm from Valencia, on the east coast, and I've lived there all my life.
Valencia.

items.q: ¿Cuánto deberías hablar en cada pregunta de Part 1?
options: Unos 20–30 segundos
Una sola palabra
Dos o tres minutos

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · PART 1 — WORK & HOMETOWN
blocks.desc: Marta responde sobre su ciudad y su trabajo. Fíjate en cómo siempre añade una razón y un detalle.

options: Valencia, on the east coast of Spain
Madrid, in the center of the country
Barcelona, on the north-east coast

questions.q: How long has she worked at the hospital?
options: About two years
Almost ten years
About four years

questions.q: What does she say is difficult about her job?
options: She doesn't get on with her colleagues at work
The hospital is too far from where she lives
It's stressful in winter, when the hospital is busy

speaking.prompt: responde tú las mismas 4 preguntas en voz alta, con la fórmula: respuesta + because + detalle.

transcript.html: Good morning. Can you tell me your full name, please?
Good morning. My name is Marta Ruiz.
Thank you. Now, where are you from?
I'm from Valencia, a city on the east coast of Spain. I've lived there all my life, and I really like it, because it's warm and it has a beautiful beach.
I work. I'm a nurse at a private hospital, and I've worked there for about four years. I chose nursing because I like helping people, although the hours can be quite long.
Yes, most of the time. I like my colleagues and I feel useful, but sometimes it's stressful, especially in winter, when the hospital is very busy.

blocks.stage: ④ LISTENING · escucha el Speaking de Marta

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · PART 1 — FREE TIME & ENGLISH
blocks.desc: Segunda tanda de preguntas. Escucha los conectores: because, also, but, so.

questions.q: Why does Marta go to the gym?
options: Because her partner goes with her
Because it's near her house
Because she sits all day at work

questions.q: How does she mostly use English?
options: At work, mostly in emails
She speaks it every day with clients
She teaches it at a school

questions.q: What does she do on Saturday evenings?
options: She goes for a walk by the sea
She sleeps late and stays home
She cooks dinner with her partner

transcript.html: Let's talk about your free time. What do you usually do after work?
Well, these days I usually go to the gym, because I sit all day at work. I also like cooking dinner with my partner. It's a nice way to relax.
Do you use English much in your daily life?
Not very often, to be honest. I use it at work sometimes, mostly in emails, and I watch series in English with subtitles. But I don't speak it every day, so that's why I'm studying now.
What's your favorite day of the week?
Definitely Saturday. I don't work, so I can sleep late and see my friends. We usually have lunch together, and in the evening we go for a walk by the sea.

blocks.title: <ico-mic></ico-mic> TU PROPIO SPEAKING PART 1
blocks.intro: Escribe tus respuestas a estas 5 preguntas de Part 1 y luego grábate diciéndolas. Cada respuesta: 2–3 frases, nunca una palabra.
checklist: Where are you from, and do you like living there?
What do you do in your free time?
Do you use English much in your daily life?
What's your favorite day of the week? Why?
blocks.placeholder: I'm from... I like it because... These days I...
blocks.example: Well, I'm from ___. I like it because ___, but ___. I work as a ___, and I've worked there for ___. In my free time I usually ___, because ___. These days I ___. My favorite day is ___, because ___.
blocks.hw: Graba tus 5 respuestas (30–40 seg cada una) usando la fórmula, sin leer — en el examen no hay papel. Envíame texto y audio.
blocks.stage: ⑤ TU TURNO · en clase o tarea (HW)

rubric.d: Escribiste lo que pide la consigna, completo y en el formato pedido.
Usaste la fórmula respuesta + razón + detalle al menos 3 veces, y bien.
Se entiende sin releer: ideas unidas, sin traducir literal del español.
